Name: 19th Century Elliott
Author: messiasmummo
Description:
After sinking a whole lot of hours into the game I'm now fairly certain that Elliott is my favourite bachelor (the other ones are too... teenagey for me :P Well except for Harvey), but I still wanted to adjust his appearance a bit.

I changed his haircolour slightly as well as his skintone (so it doesn't look like he has jaundice, also it makes sense since he sometimes says his skin is delicate), then I made some adjustments to his clothing and added some kickass sideburns. As an alternative there's also a version with his hair tied back. The sprites are also edited, so no need to worry about any mismatches there.

To install replace the files in Stardew Valley install location, make sure to backup the original files first just to be safe as well.
